name: New Jersey
short: New Jersey has no one statewide heat pump rebate, so your electric utility matters. PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric each pay up to $10,000 when a cold climate heat pump replaces gas, oil or propane heat, and $300 to $1,000 for a standard heat pump. PSE&G also pays up to $5,000 for a home battery. The state adds free Comfort Partners upgrades, up to $4,000 for an electric car and $77 per megawatt-hour solar credits. The federal tax credits ended after 2025.
